name: ResolveWfmCompetingAttemptReview
transaction_boundary: one short outer LLD-01 UnitOfWork shared with the LLD-05 WfmActivityReviewParticipant; no nested receipt/commit/rollback
authoritative_reads: exact pending wfm_competing_attempt_review proposal/revision/fingerprint/base token and immutable WFM source observation
current LLD-03 exact owning RFC identity resolved from source_observation.canonical_parent_rfc_no
current LLD-05 WFM identity/source projection and WfmImportActivityConflictSetV1
current LLD-05 SOMA_WFM_ACTIVITY_RELATIONSHIP_REVIEW_V1 authority through WfmActivityReviewParticipant
input: base_state_token lowercase sha256 equal to the proposal's WFM conflict_fingerprint
counterpart_task_id canonical UUIDv4 naming one currently conflicting same-lineage Task
activity_review_fingerprint lowercase sha256 from WfmActivityRelationshipReviewPreview for the exact current subject/counterpart seed pair and requested decision
reason_category nonempty one-line UTF-8 1..128 bytes, no NUL/CR/LF
guards: exact command replay is resolved before prepare/owner-state reads
proposal exists, is pending, kind=wfm_competing_attempt_review, risk=high, evidence_mode=observed_row and target_kind=activity_lineage
request proposal_revision/proposal_fingerprint/base_state_token exact-match persisted immutable review binding; recovery_required run has the latest exact authorization
proposal source observation is published conflict-free source_family=wfm_service_provider entity_kind=wfm identity_state=valid with exact canonical TK+14 and canonical parent NC+14
proposal target_business_id equals the observation Task No.; target_internal_id is the reviewed activity_lineage_id captured when the proposal was generated
the source observation contains a complete validated planned_start/planned_end pair; partial/malformed/blank-unscheduled plan evidence cannot support competing-attempt review
LLD-03 resolves canonical_parent_rfc_no to the exact current RFC identity; LLD-05 task_no_status must now be ACTIVE and get_by_task_no must bind the exact current Task to that RFC

the current LLD-05 accepted WFM source projection must reference the exact proposal source_observation_id and must contain the exact source-plan UTC endpoints represented by the proposal observation; therefore identity/source-projection proposals must be accepted first when this review originated from newer source evidence

call WfmImportReader.activity_conflicts in the same writer UoW with subject {task_no,current_rfc_id,task_id}, the exact proposal source interval and request counterpart_task_id; classification must be SAME_REVIEWED_LINEAGE_OVERLAP, returned activity_lineage_id must equal proposal target_internal_id, selected_counterpart must name request counterpart_task_id, and returned conflict_fingerprint must exact-match both request base_state_token and proposal base_state_token_sha256

derive seed_tasks as the canonical task_id-sorted pair {subject task_id/current tasks.revision, selected counterpart task_id/selected counterpart task_revision}; the client never chooses seed revisions or expands the reviewed closure
activity_review_fingerprint is independently recomputed by LLD-05 for the explicit decision over that exact seed pair; overlap/conflict evidence never selects the decision
idempotency: COMMAND_ENVELOPE_V1 binds proposal id/revision/fingerprint/base token, counterpart_task_id, decision, activity_review_fingerprint and reason_category; exact replay returns the immutable original ProposalDecisionResultV1 before current conflict/Task reads
receipt_order: all LLD-04/current conflict guards -> insert one outer command receipt -> call WfmActivityReviewParticipant -> accepted proposal disposition/proposal/run counters -> ticket_import.proposal_decided.v1 audit/result evidence -> commit
participant_contract: WfmActivityReviewParticipant receives the already-open UoW and outer command context. It exact-checks seed Task revisions, recomputes the complete touched-lineage review fingerprint and applies the same semantic NO_CHANGE/material lineage authority as standalone ReviewWfmActivityRelationship. It creates no receipt and never commits/rolls back. APPLIED and NO_CHANGE are both valid reviewed outcomes for this LLD-04 proposal: a NO_CHANGE means the operator explicitly confirmed the already-current classification under exact current authority, so LLD-04 may still terminally accept the review proposal while LLD-05 creates no duplicate lineage/audit history.
mutations: LLD-05 activity-lineage/event/current/Task revisions and registered owner audits only when participant result is APPLIED
import_runs accepted/pending counters and revision according to the existing LLD-04 proposal-decision contract
ticket_import.proposal_decided.v1 audit plus bounded participant owner_result_refs
rules: Generic AcceptReconciliationProposal MUST return IMPORT_PROPOSAL_BLOCKED for wfm_competing_attempt_review; only this command may accept that proposal kind.

Proposal generation may occur only when WfmImportActivityConflictSetV1.classification=SAME_REVIEWED_LINEAGE_OVERLAP. An ABSENT/unadopted Task, exact lineage absence, different reviewed lineage, unscheduled evidence, terminal local execution/outcome or mere overlap without same-lineage authority cannot emit this proposal.

The proposal base_state_token_sha256 is exactly the WfmImportActivityConflictSetV1 conflict_fingerprint from generation. The proposal fingerprint separately binds immutable source observation/change/profile evidence; neither token contains an operator decision.

The proposal target_kind is activity_lineage, target_internal_id is the reviewed subject activity_lineage_id and target_business_id is the canonical subject Task No. One explanatory ordinal-0 proposal change uses field_key=competing_attempt_counterpart, change_kind=conflict, value_kind=identity, before_text=null, after_text=suggested_counterpart_task_id and source_observation_field_id=null. The suggested counterpart is display/review evidence only and does not force the request counterpart; any requested counterpart must be revalidated as a member of the exact current fingerprint-bound conflict set.

Source identity/adoption/source projection and activity classification remain separate authorities. Accepting create/adopt or source projection cannot silently accept this review; resolving this review cannot rewrite provider source evidence or operational Task plan.
If conflict authority changed or disappeared, return IMPORT_PROPOSAL_STALE before receipt; refreshed proposal calculation may supersede the old review rather than rewriting its immutable evidence.

If LLD-05 seed revision changes, activity review fingerprint changes, retry relation is invalid, participant audit fails or any participant write fails, the complete outer UoW rolls back and the LLD-04 proposal remains pending.
No Task/TK identity is ever merged by this workflow; lineage is reviewed classification only.
revision_effects: LLD-04 proposal/run revisions increment exactly once for accepted disposition. LLD-05 affected Task/lineage revisions follow ReviewWfmActivityRelationship semantics; participant NO_CHANGE increments no LLD-05 revision.
audit_action: ticket_import.proposal_decided.v1 plus zero-or-more task.activity_relationship_reviewed.v1 owner audits from the same UoW
